title: It’s more expensive in India than it is in the US
body: I just don’t understand why developers don’t have regional pricing for their apps. A direct currency conversion puts this app’s yearly cost at about 45 usd in India. What am I missing?
author: random2817

title: Improved my quality of life so much
body: I’ve been struggling with to do lists forever. Initially I thought paying for this app is silly, but once I used it, I just can’t live without it. There are plenty of good features, but the most unique one is list time and end time, both for all tasks and for each individual task. Every other time boxing app requires you to move things around, but this works like real life. If you don’t start, it shifts everything further out so you can see if your end time still works.
author: scg_lives
